description: Vitamin D testing coverage (DoH Abu Dhabi THIQA policy, corroborated by a Daman news report) and prior-approval rules. Applied to SEAL's fictional insurers.

rules.title: Vitamin D test without a qualifying condition
rules.insurerNeeds: A qualifying condition: bone disease (rickets, osteomalacia, osteopenia, osteoporosis), chronic kidney disease, liver failure, malabsorption, parathyroid or calcium/phosphate disorders, MS/SLE/systemic sclerosis, obesity, age over 65, or a listed medicine (anti-seizure, glucocorticoids, HIV medicines, ketoconazole-type antifungals, cholestyramine).
fixTemplates: Vitamin D tested because of ____ (qualifying condition or medicine).

source.title: THIQA Coverage Policy on Management of Vitamin D Deficiency
source.section: 7.1 Medical Necessity in Testing for Vitamin D deficiency
source.quote: Testing for Vitamin D deficiency is considered medically necessary in patients with any of the following conditions or taking any of the listed medications categories: … Rickets; Osteomalacia; Osteopenia; Osteoporosis. Chronic kidney disease … Malabsorption syndromes

rules.notes: The policy is written for THIQA (Abu Dhabi). Daman's own vitamin D guideline was not found; The National (undated) reports Daman limits cover to conditions such as osteoporosis, rickets and kidney disorders: https://www.thenationalnews.com/uae/health/uae-national-health-insurer-drops-tests-for-vitamin-d-deficiency-1.140148. The policy names no denial code; MNEC-004 chosen. Scenario S3.

rules.title: Vitamin D re-tested too soon or too often
rules.insurerNeeds: Re-test no sooner than 12 weeks after starting supplements, at most two tests a year until the therapeutic goal is reached, then annually.
fixTemplates: Supplementation started on ____; previous level ____ on ____.

source.title: THIQA Coverage Policy on Management of Vitamin D Deficiency
source.quote: A patient can be re-tested to be assessed for Vitamin D deficiency 12 weeks after the initiation of vitamin D supplementation therapy. A patient is limited to only two tests per year until the vitamin D supplementation therapy reaches its therapeutic goal.

rules.notes: Policy names no denial code; MNEC-005 (too frequent) chosen.

rules.title: Billed quantity above the prior-approved quantity
rules.insurerNeeds: Billed quantity within what the prior approval covers, or an extension approved before the extra sessions.

source.title: MRI & CT Spine Adjudication Guideline — denial codes
source.quote: AUTH-005 Claim information is inconsistent with pre-certified/authorized services

rules.notes: The rule follows directly from the code's definition. Which services need prior approval is plan-specific and set in SEAL's fictional plan data (assumption). Scenario S4 (physiotherapy x6 against an approval for 4).

rules.title: Prior approval required and not obtained
rules.insurerNeeds: A prior approval for this service. Under the Dubai claims directive (effective 16 Nov 2025) the provider requests it within 1 hour of the physician's order.

source.title: Occupational Therapy Adjudication Guideline — denial codes; Dubai Health Insurance Claims Management Policy Directive (Al Tamimi summary)
source.quote: AUTH-001 Prior approval is required and was not obtained

rules.notes: Which codes need prior approval is an assumption for SEAL's fictional plans (no public Daman list found). The 1-hour timing is from https://www.tamimi.com/news/dubai-issues-comprehensive-overhaul-of-health-insurance-claims-management-framework/ (read via its Legal500 republication).
